hero.label: Independent pre-purchase car inspection
hero.title: Check a used car before you buy it.
hero.subtitle: Make your decision knowing the car's condition, rather than relying only on the listing or the seller's word.
hero.travel_note: Any applicable travel fee is agreed before the visit.

proof.label: Real inspection cases
proof.title: Findings, not guesses.
proof.intro: Sometimes an inspection helps you walk away. Sometimes it helps you buy with a clearer picture of what still needs attention.
proof.case1_alt: Photo from the Volkswagen Passat inspection
proof.case1_text: The seller described the car as being in excellent condition. The control units showed 538,000 km and significant wear.
proof.case2_text: We found worn brake discs and tyres. The overall condition was good, so we recommended buying the car.

self_check.label: I can check it myself
self_check.title: Yes. But a visual check cannot tell the whole story.
self_check.intro: Looking over the interior and bodywork and trying the car yourself is worthwhile. Other clues need measurements, diagnostic tools and an experienced reading of the findings together.
self_check.point1: A paint-thickness gauge helps reveal signs of repairs that listing photos may miss.
self_check.point2: Diagnostics can reveal control-unit faults and inconsistencies in the data.
self_check.point3: A specialist puts the findings together so you have a clearer picture before deciding.

advantage.label: Why checkauto.lt?
advantage.title: We inspect for your decision, not for the sale.
advantage.intro: Finding an issue is only part of the job. You also need to know what it means for this particular car.
advantage.item1_text: We don't work for dealers or sellers. Our fee doesn't depend on whether you buy the car.
advantage.item2_text: A specialist comes to the location you provide and checks the specific car you're considering.
advantage.item3_text: We explain the findings in plain language. A full inspection includes a photo report documenting the results.

process.title: An inspection without complicated preparation
process.intro: Found a specific car? From booking to the findings, there are just three clear steps.
process.step1_text: Tell us about the car and its location when booking. We'll confirm the visit by email.
process.step2_text: A specialist carries out the chosen inspection where the car is located.
process.step3_text: We explain the findings. After a full inspection, we send a photo report and conclusion.

quiz.label: Not sure where to start?
quiz.title: Find your next step.
quiz.intro: Two quick questions. No account or contact details—just an option that fits your situation.
quiz.question1: Have you found a specific car?
quiz.car_yes: Yes, I have a specific car
quiz.question2: What do you want to find out?
quiz.explore_text: While you're still looking, browse genuine findings. Once you have a specific car, you can book its inspection.
quiz.full_text: If you're deciding whether to buy a specific car, it's worth checking its bodywork and mechanical condition as well as its electronics.
quiz.diagnostics_text: If you only need control-unit faults and basic parameters checked, choose computer diagnostics. It does not replace a full vehicle inspection.

cta.title: Found a car you want to buy?
cta.text: Find out about its condition before you decide.
